status_summary: On 2025-09-18 FERC issued Order No. 912, directing NERC to develop supply chain risk management standards within 18 months, while declining to add country-of-origin restrictions and terminating its 2020 inquiry on equipment from entities identified as security risks. On 2026-08-26 Executive Order 14421 declared a national emergency over foreign-produced bulk-power system equipment; it prohibits covered transactions once the Secretary of Energy finds a link to a covered foreign entity and undue risk, names no country, and directs implementing rules within 120 days. On 2026-09-09 DOE published a request for information on implementing the order (responses due 2026-10-09); DOE's FAQ page, updated 2026-10-06, designates no additional country, person, equipment or vendor as covered. On 2026-09-10 FERC approved NERC's revised physical security standard CIP-014-4 for transmission stations and substations, effective 2028-10-01.

timeline.event: FERC issued Order No. 912 (dockets RM24-4 and RM20-19), directing NERC to develop supply chain risk management standards within 18 months, not imposing country-of-origin restrictions, and terminating the 2020 notice of inquiry on equipment from entities identified as national-security risks; effective 2025-11-24.

Executive Order 14421, Declaring a National Emergency To Secure the United States Bulk-Power System, was signed (published 2026-08-31); it prohibits covered acquisitions, imports and installations of foreign-produced bulk-power system equipment once the Secretary of Energy finds a link to a covered foreign entity and undue risk, and directs DOE rules within 120 days.

DOE published a request for information, Securing the United States Bulk-Power System (FR Doc. 2026-18370, 91 FR 57322; docket DOE-HQ-2026-1123; RIN 1901-AB79), seeking input on implementing Executive Order 14421 (covered equipment, foreign-entity risk criteria, existing equipment, mitigation, licensing, domestic manufacturing and federal procurement); written responses due 2026-10-09.
FERC issued an order (docket RD26-9) approving NERC's revised physical security reliability standard CIP-014-4 for transmission stations and substations, retiring CIP-014-3, effective 2028-10-01.
